The journey through electricity markets continues with a focus on *intra-day and balancing market mechanisms*, to close the gap between schedules obtained after the clearing of day-ahead markets and the real-time operation of the power system.

This module covers:

- From day-ahead market clearing to physical operation
- The intra-day market
- Definition of imbalances
- Balancing markets and their operation
- Settlement principles (one-price vs. two-price)
